16.eng: As I marveled at his benevolence, my thoughts immediately turned to an infinitely more amazing load-bearing Friend, our Savior Jesus Christ, who, as Isaiah unequivocally assured, has “borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows,” which I assumed meant the trails we travel would somehow become easier. 17.eng: Anytime we turn to Christ, we turn a corner. By His grace we can trust and expect His constant care. And because God knows our prayers even before we ask Him, it’s reasonable to assume that blessings may often materialize in the selfsame moment we verbalize. His grace, which is a duality defined as a “divine means of help or strength,” can free us from the freight we would otherwise carry. And even when we don’t perceive Him at our side, He enlists the Teds—both of this world and sometimes even the Teds beyond—with His heartening promise of angels all around us to bear us up.

17.spa: Cada vez que nos volvemos hacia Cristo, reducimos nuestra distancia a la meta. Mediante Su gracia podemos confiar en Su cuidado constante. Y debido a que Dios conoce nuestras oraciones incluso antes de que le pidamos, es razonable suponer que las bendiciones a menudo se materializan en el momento mismo en que las verbalizamos.
